tools.name: search_evidence_library
tools.description:
Find published CliniAtlas evidence answers matching a clinical question.

        Call this first for a clinical question: it is instant and does not use the user's
        free daily answers. Returns question, summary and link for each match. The library
        is a set of worked answers to common

tools.name: get_evidence_answer
tools.description:
Full published answer: cited paragraphs, limitations and graded sources.

        Use a slug from search_evidence_library. Citation markers like [1] refer to the
        numbered sources. Show the sources and intended_use with the answer.

tools.name: lookup_pubmed
tools.description:
Citation metadata for a PubMed ID: title, journal, year, authors, DOI and design.

        Abstracts are not returned; follow pubmed_url to read them.

tools.name: lookup_eu_medicine
tools.description:
Centrally authorised EU medicines by brand name or active substance.

        Returns the EMA summary, authorisation status and ema_url, the EMA page whose
        Product information section holds the SmPC. Nationally authorised medicines are not
        in this register; check the national agency

tools.name: search_medical_evidence
tools.description:
Live search of PubMed, Europe PMC and clinical guidelines.

        Returns up to eight sources for a clinical or research question, each with its study
        type, evidence level and link, usually in about 20 seconds. It does not write an
        answer: cite the sources by number, or use ask_cli

tools.name: ask_cliniatlas
tools.description:
Full CliniAtlas answer to a clinical or research question, with numbered citations.

        Searches the literature, guidelines and EMA documents and writes a cited answer, the
        same answer cliniatlas.com gives. Uncited parts are reported through grounding.
        Check search_evidence_libr

tools.name: get_cliniatlas_answer
tools.description:
Collect the answer for a job_id returned by ask_cliniatlas.

        Waits up to about 40 seconds for the result. If status is still "running", call it
        again with the same job_id.
